g.text: Boxes span documented frequency and power extents (map_value_ids); maxima need not coincide. K2 includes installed system power; single values have a small minimum size.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #6b6a64

g.text: Efficiency: mains to output; † mixed, upper end mains to absorbed power (M2). * amplifier, head or tube only (mains efficiency lower). Hatched: H1, context only.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #6b6a64

g.text: Pulsed supplies (P1) have no carrier frequency and are not shown. Lab prototypes are excluded from the boxes. M3 is drawn just right of M2; both are at 2.45 GHz.
